sprint.name: Packaging, CI and Releases
sprint.goal: Turn the app into something that can be shipped: one self-contained binary and a container image per tagged version, built and tested automatically, with a visible version number, safe upgrades, and a tested backup and restore - and move jim.tennis itself onto those releases.
focus_areas: One self-contained binary: assets embedded, no CGO
CI on every push; tagged releases with binaries and a multi-architecture image
Upgrades that back up first and stop on failure
Backup and restore as first-class, tested commands
